description: This file defines a static class with an extension method to configure and register core services into an IServiceCollection within an ASP.NET Core application. It registers various application services, repositories, logging, and email services, as well as configuration settings related to the application core.

classes.name: ConfigureCoreServices
classes.description: A static class containing extension methods to configure core application services

methods.name: AddCoreServices
methods.description: Extension method that registers core application services, repositories, logging, and configuration settings into the IServiceCollection
